The Drainage Lab

Why water flows right — or doesn't

Most driveway failures start as water problems: puddles that freeze, edges that crumble, water in the garage every storm. It almost always comes down to pitch — the slope built into the surface before the asphalt ever goes down. Try it:

¼″ / ft
≈ 2% pitch · away

The surface falls about a quarter inch for every foot of run, away from the garage and toward the street. Rain never gets the chance to sit — it sheets off, the surface dries fast, and freeze-thaw cycles have nothing to pry apart.

Done right
01 — PITCH

Slope is set before paving

The grade is cut into the base, not hoped for in the asphalt. A proper driveway falls roughly ¼ inch per foot — enough to move water, subtle enough that you'll never feel it walking.

02 — PATH

Water needs somewhere to go

Pitch alone isn't a plan. Aprons, swales, and channel drains at the garage door give runoff a route to the street or a dry well — instead of your foundation.

03 — PROTECTION

Dry asphalt lasts longer

Standing water is what cracks, heaves, and crumbles driveways in North Jersey winters. Keep water moving and the same surface lasts years longer.

What we do

Driveway work, start to finish

One crew handles the whole job — tear-out, base, drainage, paving, and finishing — so the pitch we design is the pitch you get.

/01

New asphalt driveways

Excavation, a compacted stone base graded to pitch, and hot-mix asphalt finished smooth — built for North Jersey freeze-thaw.

EXCAVATE · BASE · PAVE
/02

Driveway replacement

Full tear-out of failed pavement, re-grading to fix the slope that caused the failure, and a new surface that drains the way it should.

TEAR-OUT · RE-GRADE
/03

Drainage correction

Our specialty. Regrading, channel drains at the garage, apron work, and runoff routing for driveways that pool, flood, or ice over.

PITCH · DRAINS · APRONS
/04

Resurfacing & overlays

When the base is still sound, a fresh asphalt overlay restores the surface — with the pitch checked and corrected first, not buried.

OVERLAY · LEVEL · FINISH
/05

Repairs & sealcoating

Crack filling, patching, and sealcoating that protects the surface from water and oxidation — maintenance that actually extends life.
